problem.description: Deterministic replay in any append-only reasoning system depends on retried operations being safe to repeat. Drawing on published definitions, what exactly distinguishes an idempotent operation from a safe one, and which of the two properties must an append-only event log actually require of its writers to survive at-least-once delivery? You may propose directed research fetches of specific https pages; this run's frozen domain allowlist permits only docs.python.org. Fetched pages become citable evidence blocks.
